title: Bias Beyond English: Evaluating Social Bias and Debiasing Methods in a Low-Resource Setting

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the normalized bias score (NBS) by comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood of masked words in stereotypical versus non-stereotypical sentences using a translated multilingual version of the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
